page.overview:
What is Dusclops?

Dusclops is a ghost Pokémon with a gray oval body and stubby legs. The mask it had as a Duskull is fused to its mummy-like face. It has a single red eye, earning its name. It has three light gray wisps on its body: one on each side and the other on top of its head. It also has two light gray hands with five fingers each.

Dusclops are feared Pokémon, found patrolling ominous woods once night falls. Those that gaze into their singular red eyes are said to be able to glimpse these flames—at the cost of their lives, however, as they will absorb the spirits of anyone they make eye contact with. Dusclops can hypnotize foes by waving their hands around in a ghastly manner. Their eyes ​will glow while doing so, and their victims will be forced to do their biddings afterwards.

Dusclops has a hollow body that acts as a black hole. When it opens its mouth, it can absorb anything into its empty body. It is unknown what happens inside of it.

Dusclops evolves from Duskull starting at level 37 and evolves into Dusknoir if traded while holding a Reaper Cloth.
